newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says assessment of Japan economy unchanged.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says assessment of Japan economy unchanged.

text.p: A senior Bank of Japan (BOJ) official said on Tuesday that the central bank's assessment of current economic conditions had not changed.
The official made the remarks after the BOJ issued its monthly report on the economy, in which it said that a moderate economic recovery was continuing in Japan.
"From the economic data available at the moment we don't find it necessary to change our official view about current economic conditions," the official said.
The monthly report said economic recovery was gradually gaining momentum over a wider area, particularly in corporate capital spending.
Industrial production showed wide monthly fluctuations, but a gradual upward trend remained intact, the official said.
The official said he was worried that a deterioration in the semiconductor market could adversely affect overall capital spending and production.
The report said a slow but steady recovery continued in personal consumption.
Overall labour market conditions improved somewhat, although Japan's unemployment rate remained at a high level, it said.
The report said capital spending remained on a firm recovery trend on the whole despite some fluctuations in the manufacturing sector in the July-September quarter.
